newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait's Shuaiba refinery suffers power failure.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait's Shuaiba refinery suffers power failure.

text.p: Kuwait's 200,000 barrels per day (bpd) Shuaiba refinery on Tuesday suffered power failure that has stopped all of its operations for a short period, the official Kuwait News Agency said on Tuesday.

"The electric current was restored shortly after the occurrence of the failure. Efforts are being exerted to operate the refinery's units gradually," the agency quoted a statement by the state-owned oil refiner Kuwait National Petroleum Co (KNPC).
The agency did not give the duration of the stoppage or the current output of the refinery.
Kuwait has a total domestic refining capacity of 895,000 bpd through its three KNPC-run refineries.
KNPC said the failure took place when technicians were running a routine check on electrical systems at the refinery's power equipment.
The reasons that led to the stoppage are being investigated, it added.
